projects.title: QuantumUQ
projects.description: Open-source toolkit for uncertainty quantification in quantum machine learning (Qiskit + PennyLane).

projects.title: Trustworthy AI
projects.description: Practical guide to building reliable and secure AI systems.

projects.title: Secure AI for 6G / Next-Gen Communications
projects.description: Robust signal intelligence, adversarial resilience, and uncertainty-aware inference for future networks.

projects.title: BERT4MIMO-AI4Wireless
projects.description: MIMO4BERT/CSIBERT model for Channel State Information reconstruction and prediction in dynamic wireless environments. Transformer-based; includes data preprocessing, training, and evaluation. Publication: BERT4MIMO (arXiv:2501.01802).

projects.title: malware_api_class
projects.description: Public malware dataset from Cuckoo Sandbox (Windows API calls). Benchmark for PE malware classification and metamorphic malware behavior; eight families (Trojan, Backdoor, Downloader, Worms, Spyware, Adware, Dropper, Virus). CSV format for ML.

projects.title: 6g-channel-estimation-dataset
projects.description: Dataset and code for defensive distillation-based mitigation of adversarial attacks on DL channel estimation (5G/6G). MATLAB 5G Toolbox; vulnerability analysis and defensive distillation. IEEE Access 2022.

projects.title: attention_based_automatic_modulation_recognition
projects.description: Comparative study of attention mechanisms for Automatic Modulation Classification on RF signals. CNN-Transformer hybrid: baseline, causal, and sparse attention. RML2016.10a; training, experiments, visualizations. IEEE.

projects.title: Trustworthy AI (book code)
projects.description: Companion code for the book: Python examples for uncertainty quantification, adversarial ML, explainability, federated learning, homomorphic encryption. By chapter (Chap-2–6). DAT945 / NORA.AI.

projects.title: Homomorphic-Neural-Cryptography
projects.description: Asymmetric neural cryptography with homomorphic and probabilistic properties. Five networks (Alice, Bob, Eve, HO Addition, HO Multiplication); elliptic-curve keys; homomorphic add/multiply on ciphertexts. Python.
